findings.title: Unused IpcFailed reason
findings.evidence: The old getAppInfo Effect.tryPromise was the only producer of 'IpcFailed'; the new layer only emits NotInElectron and ConnectTimeout.

findings.title: Origin check is a prefix match
findings.evidence: frame.url.startsWith(allowedOrigin()) with allowedOrigin = ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL or 'file://'. A prefix like http://localhost:4200 also matches http://localhost:4200.evil.example, and 'file://' matches any local file. Comment says it must match main.ts navigation rule but it is a separate copy.
findings.fix: Parse with new URL(frame.url) and compare origin (or exact file path of the app index) using the same helper as main.ts.

findings.title: connect() stacks ipcRenderer.once listeners and posts to '*'
findings.evidence: Each connect() call adds a new once listener; one reply fires all of them, so the port is posted once and later posts carry empty ports, and a retry or second call leaves stale listeners. window.postMessage(..., '*') lets any script in the page see the message; the renderer only checks event.source === window and data tag, so page script could also forge a port.
findings.fix: Guard against concurrent connect (single pending flag) and post with the window's own origin instead of '*'.

findings.title: Floating Effect.runFork in port callbacks
findings.evidence: Effect.runFork(writeResponse(0, response)) and Effect.runFork(writeRequest(0, request)) run effects outside the edge, unscoped, so they are not interrupted when the protocol scope closes. AGENTS.md forbids floating effects.
findings.fix: Capture Effect.runtime / use Effect.runForkWith with the scope's services and fork into the scope (Effect.forkIn).

findings.title: AGENTS.md says MsgPack, code uses layerSchemaBinary
findings.evidence: CLAUDE.md notes MsgPack is unavailable in 4.0.7 and uses RpcSerialization.layerSchemaBinary, while AGENTS.md (mandatory rules) still says RPC over MessagePort with MsgPack. The rule and the code disagree and the deviation is only recorded in CLAUDE.md.
findings.fix: Update AGENTS.md to name the actual serialization or note the exception.
